About

1. Cookies

Cookies are text files containing small amount of information which are stored on your device when you visit a website. Our website use cookies and other tracking technologies to understand the usage of our website and to make its contents, design, or services more user-friendly and customized for your needs. Some optional cookies specified in Section 2 (b, c and d) require your consent before we use them on our website. So please read through this cookie policy and let us know your acceptance for each category of cookies from the cookie banner. Cookies will not be used for any purpose other than what described on this cookie policy and your consent can be withdrawn anytime within the cookie banner mentioned above or by the process described in Section 3.

 

2. Categories of Cookies

We use following four categories of cookies based on the function and the purpose for which they are used:

   a. Necessary Cookies: Necessary cookies help make a website usable by enabling basic functions like page navigation and access to secure areas of the website. The website cannot function properly without these cookies.

   b. Preference Cookies: Preference cookies enable a website to remember information that changes the way the website behaves or looks, like your preferred language or the region that you are in.

   c. Statistic Cookies: Statistic cookies help website owners to understand how visitors interact with websites by collecting and reporting information anonymously.

   d. Marketing Cookies: Marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and engaging for the individual user and thereby more valuable for publishers and third party advertisers.

 

Cookies are also classified based on who set the cookies and how long cookies are stored: 

  • First party cookies: these cookies are generated by our website (the same domain as in the address bar). 
  • Third party cookie: these cookies are generated by a domain other than that of our website. 
  • Session cookies: these cookies are created temporally and deleted when you close the browser. 
  • Persistent cookies: these cookies remain on user’s device for the specific period of time. 

Our website have some links to third party websites (such as our dealer’s websites) which may also use cookies. It is recommended that you check the relevant information on the cookie policy of each webpage.

 

3. How to Disable Cookies

Most browsers are set up to accept cookies but you can disable them anytime by changing the settings of your browser. Since the process to change the setting differs between each browser, please refer to each support page for the details. Followings are the support pages of browsers widely used:

 

  • Internet Explorer：https://support.microsoft.com 
  • Firefox：https://support.mozilla.org 
  • Chrome：https://support.google.com/chrome/
